notes.note: Delta-review round on #5007: parking section rewritten against the narrowed sources. The idle park's hasOpenEngineWork sentence is main's again, and the page states that the same check guards the recovery replay and full-access relaunch (isParkableIdleSession). The finished-session park's conditions are now listed: an unattended newest sent turn; no person turn, which counts every steer as well as unrecognised-origin turns and skips provider-triggered ones; and openEngineWork 'complete' with no earlyParkRefusal. Claude refuses on housekeeping tasks, non-sdk or unreported MCP servers, and reported or unknown wakeups, re-read under the lock. The ACP terminal veto is removed. Each claim is covered by finished-session-parking.test.ts and claude-adapter-early-park.test.ts, fault-injected (D1-D11).

STATION_IDLE_SESSION_PARK_AFTER_MS row: the idle-park veto list is main's again (open request, running child work, an unended task, no resumable engine). The early-park sentence now names its actual conditions (a delegation, Automation or Task dispatch turn; no person send; Claude with only Station's own MCP servers, no scheduled wakeup and no housekeeping task running), checked against parkFinishedSession and ClaudeAdapter.earlyParkRefusal.
Adds the optional earlyParkRefusal method and revises the openEngineWork comment. The citing pages (agent smoke confidence, contracts) make no claim about these adapter members; they remain accurate.
